answer: Epoch 126 times a single-file gate that opens once every fifteen minutes. A key posts a 16 POA bond and presents one onyx to wander the sill; the gate records a fresh plume. A jumped line, a reused onyx, a copied plume, or a missed call burns the 16 POA bond. The public tape lists each opening's plume, onyx mark, and call time. Twelve openings fill the watch, so a farm of 400 keys that can pass only twelve openings burns 16 POA on each of the other 388 keys: 388 x 16 = 6,208 POA the attacker forfeits.
